product_metadata.title: Crofy 2 Pack Car Neck Pillow, Softness Car Headrest Pillow for Driving with Adjustable Strap, 100% Memory Foam and Breathable Removable Cover, Comfortable Ergonomic Design (Beige)

ELASTIC ADJUSTABLE STRAPS: High-quality buckle highly secure on your seat prevent neck pillow for car slip down or fall away from the seat, giving a fixed hold and better to support your neck, you can adjust the height of your car pillow you want.
